description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows DeepSeek account balance, token usage and cost for today/month/all-time in the chat UI, with draggable panel order settings and an optional local proxy that records API usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，在聊天界面展示 DeepSeek 账户余额、今日/本月/累计 token 用量与费用，支持拖拽排序面板配置，并提供可选的本地代理记录 API 用量。
